title: Drunk Man Attempts to Take Deputy’s Gun After Fleeing Three Times
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 25, 2022, a Monroe County Sheriff’s deputy conducted a traffic stop after observing a disabled vehicle in Sparta, WI. While speaking with the male driver, the deputy noticed his slurred speech and bloodshot eyes. It was later determined he was operating while intoxicated after performing tests and providing a sample of his breath. When the deputy attempted to take him into custody, the male pulled away and ran off into the darkness. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
